00043 static inline bool  FFTReal_is_pow2 (long x)
00044 {
00045     assert (x > 0);
00046 
00047     return  ((x & -x) == x);
00048 }
00049 
00050 
00051 
00052 static inline int   FFTReal_get_next_pow2 (long x)
00053 {
00054     --x;
00055 
00056     int             p = 0;
00057     while ((x & ~0xFFFFL) != 0)
00058     {
00059         p += 16;
00060         x >>= 16;
00061     }
00062     while ((x & ~0xFL) != 0)
00063     {
00064         p += 4;
00065         x >>= 4;
00066     }
00067     while (x > 0)
00068     {
00069         ++p;
00070         x >>= 1;
00071     }
00072 
00073     return (p);
00074 }

00129 /*
00130 ==============================================================================
00131 Name: do_fft
00132 Description:
00133     Compute the FFT of the array.
00134 Input parameters:
00135     - x: pointer on the source array (time).
00136 Output parameters:
00137     - f: pointer on the destination array (frequencies).
00138         f [0...length(x)/2] = real values,
00139         f [length(x)/2+1...length(x)-1] = negative imaginary values of
00140         coefficents 1...length(x)/2-1.
00141 Throws: Nothing
00142 ==============================================================================
00143 */
00144 
00145 template <class DT>
00146 void    FFTReal <DT>::do_fft (DataType f [], const DataType x []) const
00147 {
00148     assert (f != 0);
00149     assert (f != use_buffer ());
00150     assert (x != 0);
00151     assert (x != use_buffer ());
00152     assert (x != f);
00153 
00154     // General case
00155     if (_nbr_bits > 2)
00156     {
00157         compute_fft_general (f, x);
00158     }
00159 
00160     // 4-point FFT
00161     else if (_nbr_bits == 2)
00162     {
00163         f [1] = x [0] - x [2];
00164         f [3] = x [1] - x [3];
00165 
00166         const DataType  b_0 = x [0] + x [2];
00167         const DataType  b_2 = x [1] + x [3];
00168         
00169         f [0] = b_0 + b_2;
00170         f [2] = b_0 - b_2;
00171     }
00172 
00173     // 2-point FFT
00174     else if (_nbr_bits == 1)
00175     {
00176         f [0] = x [0] + x [1];
00177         f [1] = x [0] - x [1];
00178     }
00179 
00180     // 1-point FFT
00181     else
00182     {
00183         f [0] = x [0];
00184     }
00185 }
00186

00189 /*
00190 ==============================================================================
00191 Name: do_ifft
00192 Description:
00193     Compute the inverse FFT of the array. Note that data must be post-scaled:
00194     IFFT (FFT (x)) = x * length (x).
00195 Input parameters:
00196     - f: pointer on the source array (frequencies).
00197         f [0...length(x)/2] = real values
00198         f [length(x)/2+1...length(x)-1] = negative imaginary values of
00199         coefficents 1...length(x)/2-1.
00200 Output parameters:
00201     - x: pointer on the destination array (time).
00202 Throws: Nothing
00203 ==============================================================================
00204 */
00205 
00206 template <class DT>
00207 void    FFTReal <DT>::do_ifft (const DataType f [], DataType x []) const
00208 {
00209     assert (f != 0);
00210     assert (f != use_buffer ());
00211     assert (x != 0);
00212     assert (x != use_buffer ());
00213     assert (x != f);
00214 
00215     // General case
00216     if (_nbr_bits > 2)
00217     {
00218         compute_ifft_general (f, x);
00219     }
00220 
00221     // 4-point IFFT
00222     else if (_nbr_bits == 2)
00223     {
00224         const DataType  b_0 = f [0] + f [2];
00225         const DataType  b_2 = f [0] - f [2];
00226 
00227         x [0] = b_0 + f [1] * 2;
00228         x [2] = b_0 - f [1] * 2;
00229         x [1] = b_2 + f [3] * 2;
00230         x [3] = b_2 - f [3] * 2;
00231     }
00232 
00233     // 2-point IFFT
00234     else if (_nbr_bits == 1)
00235     {
00236         x [0] = f [0] + f [1];
00237         x [1] = f [0] - f [1];
00238     }
00239 
00240     // 1-point IFFT
00241     else
00242     {
00243         x [0] = f [0];
00244     }
00245 }

00249 /*
00250 ==============================================================================
00251 Name: rescale
00252 Description:
00253     Scale an array by divide each element by its length. This function should
00254     be called after FFT + IFFT.
00255 Input parameters:
00256     - x: pointer on array to rescale (time or frequency).
00257 Throws: Nothing
00258 ==============================================================================
00259 */
00260 
00261 template <class DT>
00262 void    FFTReal <DT>::rescale (DataType x []) const
00263 {
00264     const DataType  mul = DataType (1.0 / _length);
00265 
00266     if (_length < 4)
00267     {
00268         long                i = _length - 1;
00269         do
00270         {
00271             x [i] *= mul;
00272             --i;
00273         }
00274         while (i >= 0);
00275     }
00276 
00277     else
00278     {
00279         assert ((_length & 3) == 0);
00280 
00281         // Could be optimized with SIMD instruction sets (needs alignment check)
00282         long                i = _length - 4;
00283         do
00284         {
00285             x [i + 0] *= mul;
00286             x [i + 1] *= mul;
00287             x [i + 2] *= mul;
00288             x [i + 3] *= mul;
00289             i -= 4;
00290         }
00291         while (i >= 0);
00292     }
00293 }

00328 template <class DT>
00329 void    FFTReal <DT>::init_br_lut ()
00330 {
00331     const long      length = 1L << _nbr_bits;
00332     _br_lut.resize (length);
00333 
00334     _br_lut [0] = 0;
00335     long                br_index = 0;
00336     for (long cnt = 1; cnt < length; ++cnt)
00337     {
00338         // ++br_index (bit reversed)
00339         long                bit = length >> 1;
00340         while (((br_index ^= bit) & bit) == 0)
00341         {
00342             bit >>= 1;
00343         }
00344 
00345         _br_lut [cnt] = br_index;
00346     }
00347 }
00348

00351 template <class DT>
00352 void    FFTReal <DT>::init_trigo_lut ()
00353 {
00354     using namespace std;
00355 
00356     if (_nbr_bits > 3)
00357     {
00358         const long      total_len = (1L << (_nbr_bits - 1)) - 4;
00359         _trigo_lut.resize (total_len);
00360 
00361         for (int level = 3; level < _nbr_bits; ++level)
00362         {
00363             const long      level_len = 1L << (level - 1);
00364             DataType    * const level_ptr =
00365                 &_trigo_lut [get_trigo_level_index (level)];
00366             const double    mul = PI / (level_len << 1);
00367 
00368             for (long i = 0; i < level_len; ++ i)
00369             {
00370                 level_ptr [i] = static_cast <DataType> (cos (i * mul));
00371             }
00372         }
00373     }
00374 }

00378 template <class DT>
00379 void    FFTReal <DT>::init_trigo_osc ()
00380 {
00381     const int       nbr_osc = _nbr_bits - TRIGO_BD_LIMIT;
00382     if (nbr_osc > 0)
00383     {
00384         _trigo_osc.resize (nbr_osc);
00385 
00386         for (int osc_cnt = 0; osc_cnt < nbr_osc; ++osc_cnt)
00387         {
00388             OscType &       osc = _trigo_osc [osc_cnt];
00389 
00390             const long      len = 1L << (TRIGO_BD_LIMIT + osc_cnt);
00391             const double    mul = (0.5 * PI) / len;
00392             osc.set_step (mul);
00393         }
00394     }
00395 }

00427 // Transform in several passes
00428 template <class DT>
00429 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_fft_general (DataType f [], const DataType x []) const
00430 {
00431     assert (f != 0);
00432     assert (f != use_buffer ());
00433     assert (x != 0);
00434     assert (x != use_buffer ());
00435     assert (x != f);
00436 
00437     DataType *      sf;
00438     DataType *      df;
00439 
00440     if ((_nbr_bits & 1) != 0)
00441     {
00442         df = use_buffer ();
00443         sf = f;
00444     }
00445     else
00446     {
00447         df = f;
00448         sf = use_buffer ();
00449     }
00450 
00451     compute_direct_pass_1_2 (df, x);
00452     compute_direct_pass_3 (sf, df);
00453 
00454     for (int pass = 3; pass < _nbr_bits; ++ pass)
00455     {
00456         compute_direct_pass_n (df, sf, pass);
00457 
00458         DataType * const    temp_ptr = df;
00459         df = sf;
00460         sf = temp_ptr;
00461     }
00462 }
00463 
00464 
00465 
00466 template <class DT>
00467 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_direct_pass_1_2 (DataType df [], const DataType x []) const
00468 {
00469     assert (df != 0);
00470     assert (x != 0);
00471     assert (df != x);
00472 
00473     const long * const  bit_rev_lut_ptr = get_br_ptr ();
00474     long                coef_index = 0;
00475     do
00476     {
00477         const long      rev_index_0 = bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index];
00478         const long      rev_index_1 = bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 1];
00479         const long      rev_index_2 = bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 2];
00480         const long      rev_index_3 = bit_rev_lut_ptr [coef_index + 3];
00481 
00482         DataType    * const df2 = df + coef_index;
00483         df2 [1] = x [rev_index_0] - x [rev_index_1];
00484         df2 [3] = x [rev_index_2] - x [rev_index_3];
00485 
00486         const DataType  sf_0 = x [rev_index_0] + x [rev_index_1];
00487         const DataType  sf_2 = x [rev_index_2] + x [rev_index_3];
00488 
00489         df2 [0] = sf_0 + sf_2;
00490         df2 [2] = sf_0 - sf_2;
00491         
00492         coef_index += 4;
00493     }
00494     while (coef_index < _length);
00495 }
00496

00498 
00499 template <class DT>
00500 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_direct_pass_3 (DataType df [], const DataType sf []) const
00501 {
00502     assert (df != 0);
00503     assert (sf != 0);
00504     assert (df != sf);
00505 
00506     const DataType  sqrt2_2 = DataType (SQRT2 * 0.5);
00507     long                coef_index = 0;
00508     do
00509     {
00510         DataType            v;
00511 
00512         df [coef_index] = sf [coef_index] + sf [coef_index + 4];
00513         df [coef_index + 4] = sf [coef_index] - sf [coef_index + 4];
00514         df [coef_index + 2] = sf [coef_index + 2];
00515         df [coef_index + 6] = sf [coef_index + 6];
00516 
00517         v = (sf [coef_index + 5] - sf [coef_index + 7]) * sqrt2_2;
00518         df [coef_index + 1] = sf [coef_index + 1] + v;
00519         df [coef_index + 3] = sf [coef_index + 1] - v;
00520 
00521         v = (sf [coef_index + 5] + sf [coef_index + 7]) * sqrt2_2;
00522         df [coef_index + 5] = v + sf [coef_index + 3];
00523         df [coef_index + 7] = v - sf [coef_index + 3];
00524 
00525         coef_index += 8;
00526     }
00527     while (coef_index < _length);
00528 }

00532 template <class DT>
00533 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_direct_pass_n (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00534 {
00535     assert (df != 0);
00536     assert (sf != 0);
00537     assert (df != sf);
00538     assert (pass >= 3);
00539     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00540 
00541     if (pass <= TRIGO_BD_LIMIT)
00542     {
00543         compute_direct_pass_n_lut (df, sf, pass);
00544     }
00545     else
00546     {
00547         compute_direct_pass_n_osc (df, sf, pass);
00548     }
00549 }

00551 
00552 
00553 template <class DT>
00554 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_direct_pass_n_lut (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00555 {
00556     assert (df != 0);
00557     assert (sf != 0);
00558     assert (df != sf);
00559     assert (pass >= 3);
00560     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00561 
00562     const long      nbr_coef = 1 << pass;
00563     const long      h_nbr_coef = nbr_coef >> 1;
00564     const long      d_nbr_coef = nbr_coef << 1;
00565     long                coef_index = 0;
00566     const DataType  * const cos_ptr = get_trigo_ptr (pass);
00567     do
00568     {
00569         const DataType  * const sf1r = sf + coef_index;
00570         const DataType  * const sf2r = sf1r + nbr_coef;
00571         DataType            * const dfr = df + coef_index;
00572         DataType            * const dfi = dfr + nbr_coef;
00573 
00574         // Extreme coefficients are always real
00575         dfr [0] = sf1r [0] + sf2r [0];
00576         dfi [0] = sf1r [0] - sf2r [0];  // dfr [nbr_coef] =
00577         dfr [h_nbr_coef] = sf1r [h_nbr_coef];
00578         dfi [h_nbr_coef] = sf2r [h_nbr_coef];
00579 
00580         // Others are conjugate complex numbers
00581         const DataType * const  sf1i = sf1r + h_nbr_coef;
00582         const DataType * const  sf2i = sf1i + nbr_coef;
00583         for (long i = 1; i < h_nbr_coef; ++ i)
00584         {
00585             const DataType  c = cos_ptr [i];                    // cos (i*PI/nbr_coef);
00586             const DataType  s = cos_ptr [h_nbr_coef - i];   // sin (i*PI/nbr_coef);
00587             DataType            v;
00588 
00589             v = sf2r [i] * c - sf2i [i] * s;
00590             dfr [i] = sf1r [i] + v;
00591             dfi [-i] = sf1r [i] - v;    // dfr [nbr_coef - i] =
00592 
00593             v = sf2r [i] * s + sf2i [i] * c;
00594             dfi [i] = v + sf1i [i];
00595             dfi [nbr_coef - i] = v - sf1i [i];
00596         }
00597 
00598         coef_index += d_nbr_coef;
00599     }
00600     while (coef_index < _length);
00601 }
00602 
00603 
00604 
00605 template <class DT>
00606 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_direct_pass_n_osc (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00607 {
00608     assert (df != 0);
00609     assert (sf != 0);
00610     assert (df != sf);
00611     assert (pass > TRIGO_BD_LIMIT);
00612     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00613 
00614     const long      nbr_coef = 1 << pass;
00615     const long      h_nbr_coef = nbr_coef >> 1;
00616     const long      d_nbr_coef = nbr_coef << 1;
00617     long                coef_index = 0;
00618     OscType &       osc = _trigo_osc [pass - (TRIGO_BD_LIMIT + 1)];
00619     do
00620     {
00621         const DataType  * const sf1r = sf + coef_index;
00622         const DataType  * const sf2r = sf1r + nbr_coef;
00623         DataType            * const dfr = df + coef_index;
00624         DataType            * const dfi = dfr + nbr_coef;
00625 
00626         osc.clear_buffers ();
00627 
00628         // Extreme coefficients are always real
00629         dfr [0] = sf1r [0] + sf2r [0];
00630         dfi [0] = sf1r [0] - sf2r [0];  // dfr [nbr_coef] =
00631         dfr [h_nbr_coef] = sf1r [h_nbr_coef];
00632         dfi [h_nbr_coef] = sf2r [h_nbr_coef];
00633 
00634         // Others are conjugate complex numbers
00635         const DataType * const  sf1i = sf1r + h_nbr_coef;
00636         const DataType * const  sf2i = sf1i + nbr_coef;
00637         for (long i = 1; i < h_nbr_coef; ++ i)
00638         {
00639             osc.step ();
00640             const DataType  c = osc.get_cos ();
00641             const DataType  s = osc.get_sin ();
00642             DataType            v;
00643 
00644             v = sf2r [i] * c - sf2i [i] * s;
00645             dfr [i] = sf1r [i] + v;
00646             dfi [-i] = sf1r [i] - v;    // dfr [nbr_coef - i] =
00647 
00648             v = sf2r [i] * s + sf2i [i] * c;
00649             dfi [i] = v + sf1i [i];
00650             dfi [nbr_coef - i] = v - sf1i [i];
00651         }
00652 
00653         coef_index += d_nbr_coef;
00654     }
00655     while (coef_index < _length);
00656 }

00660 // Transform in several pass
00661 template <class DT>
00662 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_ifft_general (const DataType f [], DataType x []) const
00663 {
00664     assert (f != 0);
00665     assert (f != use_buffer ());
00666     assert (x != 0);
00667     assert (x != use_buffer ());
00668     assert (x != f);
00669 
00670     DataType *      sf = const_cast <DataType *> (f);
00671     DataType *      df;
00672     DataType *      df_temp;
00673 
00674     if (_nbr_bits & 1)
00675     {
00676         df = use_buffer ();
00677         df_temp = x;
00678     }
00679     else
00680     {
00681         df = x;
00682         df_temp = use_buffer ();
00683     }
00684 
00685     for (int pass = _nbr_bits - 1; pass >= 3; -- pass)
00686     {
00687         compute_inverse_pass_n (df, sf, pass);
00688 
00689         if (pass < _nbr_bits - 1)
00690         {
00691             DataType    * const temp_ptr = df;
00692             df = sf;
00693             sf = temp_ptr;
00694         }
00695         else
00696         {
00697             sf = df;
00698             df = df_temp;
00699         }
00700     }
00701 
00702     compute_inverse_pass_3 (df, sf);
00703     compute_inverse_pass_1_2 (x, df);
00704 }

00708 template <class DT>
00709 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_inverse_pass_n (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00710 {
00711     assert (df != 0);
00712     assert (sf != 0);
00713     assert (df != sf);
00714     assert (pass >= 3);
00715     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00716 
00717     if (pass <= TRIGO_BD_LIMIT)
00718     {
00719         compute_inverse_pass_n_lut (df, sf, pass);
00720     }
00721     else
00722     {
00723         compute_inverse_pass_n_osc (df, sf, pass);
00724     }
00725 }

00729 template <class DT>
00730 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_inverse_pass_n_lut (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00731 {
00732     assert (df != 0);
00733     assert (sf != 0);
00734     assert (df != sf);
00735     assert (pass >= 3);
00736     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00737 
00738     const long      nbr_coef = 1 << pass;
00739     const long      h_nbr_coef = nbr_coef >> 1;
00740     const long      d_nbr_coef = nbr_coef << 1;
00741     long                coef_index = 0;
00742     const DataType * const  cos_ptr = get_trigo_ptr (pass);
00743     do
00744     {
00745         const DataType  * const sfr = sf + coef_index;
00746         const DataType  * const sfi = sfr + nbr_coef;
00747         DataType            * const df1r = df + coef_index;
00748         DataType            * const df2r = df1r + nbr_coef;
00749 
00750         // Extreme coefficients are always real
00751         df1r [0] = sfr [0] + sfi [0];       // + sfr [nbr_coef]
00752         df2r [0] = sfr [0] - sfi [0];       // - sfr [nbr_coef]
00753         df1r [h_nbr_coef] = sfr [h_nbr_coef] * 2;
00754         df2r [h_nbr_coef] = sfi [h_nbr_coef] * 2;
00755 
00756         // Others are conjugate complex numbers
00757         DataType * const    df1i = df1r + h_nbr_coef;
00758         DataType * const    df2i = df1i + nbr_coef;
00759         for (long i = 1; i < h_nbr_coef; ++ i)
00760         {
00761             df1r [i] = sfr [i] + sfi [-i];      // + sfr [nbr_coef - i]
00762             df1i [i] = sfi [i] - sfi [nbr_coef - i];
00763 
00764             const DataType  c = cos_ptr [i];                    // cos (i*PI/nbr_coef);
00765             const DataType  s = cos_ptr [h_nbr_coef - i];   // sin (i*PI/nbr_coef);
00766             const DataType  vr = sfr [i] - sfi [-i];        // - sfr [nbr_coef - i]
00767             const DataType  vi = sfi [i] + sfi [nbr_coef - i];
00768 
00769             df2r [i] = vr * c + vi * s;
00770             df2i [i] = vi * c - vr * s;
00771         }
00772 
00773         coef_index += d_nbr_coef;
00774     }
00775     while (coef_index < _length);
00776 }

00780 template <class DT>
00781 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_inverse_pass_n_osc (DataType df [], const DataType sf [], int pass) const
00782 {
00783     assert (df != 0);
00784     assert (sf != 0);
00785     assert (df != sf);
00786     assert (pass > TRIGO_BD_LIMIT);
00787     assert (pass < _nbr_bits);
00788 
00789     const long      nbr_coef = 1 << pass;
00790     const long      h_nbr_coef = nbr_coef >> 1;
00791     const long      d_nbr_coef = nbr_coef << 1;
00792     long                coef_index = 0;
00793     OscType &       osc = _trigo_osc [pass - (TRIGO_BD_LIMIT + 1)];
00794     do
00795     {
00796         const DataType  * const sfr = sf + coef_index;
00797         const DataType  * const sfi = sfr + nbr_coef;
00798         DataType            * const df1r = df + coef_index;
00799         DataType            * const df2r = df1r + nbr_coef;
00800 
00801         osc.clear_buffers ();
00802 
00803         // Extreme coefficients are always real
00804         df1r [0] = sfr [0] + sfi [0];       // + sfr [nbr_coef]
00805         df2r [0] = sfr [0] - sfi [0];       // - sfr [nbr_coef]
00806         df1r [h_nbr_coef] = sfr [h_nbr_coef] * 2;
00807         df2r [h_nbr_coef] = sfi [h_nbr_coef] * 2;
00808 
00809         // Others are conjugate complex numbers
00810         DataType * const    df1i = df1r + h_nbr_coef;
00811         DataType * const    df2i = df1i + nbr_coef;
00812         for (long i = 1; i < h_nbr_coef; ++ i)
00813         {
00814             df1r [i] = sfr [i] + sfi [-i];      // + sfr [nbr_coef - i]
00815             df1i [i] = sfi [i] - sfi [nbr_coef - i];
00816 
00817             osc.step ();
00818             const DataType  c = osc.get_cos ();
00819             const DataType  s = osc.get_sin ();
00820             const DataType  vr = sfr [i] - sfi [-i];        // - sfr [nbr_coef - i]
00821             const DataType  vi = sfi [i] + sfi [nbr_coef - i];
00822 
00823             df2r [i] = vr * c + vi * s;
00824             df2i [i] = vi * c - vr * s;
00825         }
00826 
00827         coef_index += d_nbr_coef;
00828     }
00829     while (coef_index < _length);
00830 }

00834 template <class DT>
00835 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_inverse_pass_3 (DataType df [], const DataType sf []) const
00836 {
00837     assert (df != 0);
00838     assert (sf != 0);
00839     assert (df != sf);
00840 
00841     const DataType  sqrt2_2 = DataType (SQRT2 * 0.5);
00842     long                coef_index = 0;
00843     do
00844     {
00845         df [coef_index] = sf [coef_index] + sf [coef_index + 4];
00846         df [coef_index + 4] = sf [coef_index] - sf [coef_index + 4];
00847         df [coef_index + 2] = sf [coef_index + 2] * 2;
00848         df [coef_index + 6] = sf [coef_index + 6] * 2;
00849 
00850         df [coef_index + 1] = sf [coef_index + 1] + sf [coef_index + 3];
00851         df [coef_index + 3] = sf [coef_index + 5] - sf [coef_index + 7];
00852 
00853         const DataType  vr = sf [coef_index + 1] - sf [coef_index + 3];
00854         const DataType  vi = sf [coef_index + 5] + sf [coef_index + 7];
00855 
00856         df [coef_index + 5] = (vr + vi) * sqrt2_2;
00857         df [coef_index + 7] = (vi - vr) * sqrt2_2;
00858 
00859         coef_index += 8;
00860     }
00861     while (coef_index < _length);
00862 }

00866 template <class DT>
00867 void    FFTReal <DT>::compute_inverse_pass_1_2 (DataType x [], const DataType sf []) const
00868 {
00869     assert (x != 0);
00870     assert (sf != 0);
00871     assert (x != sf);
00872 
00873     const long *    bit_rev_lut_ptr = get_br_ptr ();
00874     const DataType *    sf2 = sf;
00875     long                coef_index = 0;
00876     do
00877     {
00878         {
00879             const DataType  b_0 = sf2 [0] + sf2 [2];
00880             const DataType  b_2 = sf2 [0] - sf2 [2];
00881             const DataType  b_1 = sf2 [1] * 2;
00882             const DataType  b_3 = sf2 [3] * 2;
00883 
00884             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [0]] = b_0 + b_1;
00885             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [1]] = b_0 - b_1;
00886             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [2]] = b_2 + b_3;
00887             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [3]] = b_2 - b_3;
00888         }
00889         {
00890             const DataType  b_0 = sf2 [4] + sf2 [6];
00891             const DataType  b_2 = sf2 [4] - sf2 [6];
00892             const DataType  b_1 = sf2 [5] * 2;
00893             const DataType  b_3 = sf2 [7] * 2;
00894 
00895             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [4]] = b_0 + b_1;
00896             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [5]] = b_0 - b_1;
00897             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [6]] = b_2 + b_3;
00898             x [bit_rev_lut_ptr [7]] = b_2 - b_3;
00899         }
00900 
00901         sf2 += 8;
00902         coef_index += 8;
00903         bit_rev_lut_ptr += 8;
00904     }
00905     while (coef_index < _length);
00906 }
